detail.longDescription: my take: margins are a lagging signal. most big companies bolted a chatbot onto the old process, and the payoff shows up when the process itself changes but "we're early" can't be the answer forever. what number would you show a CFO to prove AI paid off? https:// techcrunch.com/2026/10/25/ai-d elivers-zero-financial-payoff-to-most-companies-according-to-apollo-economist/ # AI # Economics # Startups # Productivity
